verdict.rationale: Algolia Rules let you set conditional overrides that apply automatically to matching searches, such as seasonal promotions, repositioning products, or temporary changes [algolia-docs-6, algolia-docs-56, algolia-docs-72]. Algolia can also run scheduled data ingestion with retries and transformations without deploying code [algolia-docs-48]. However, these rules are limited to adjusting search relevance. Nothing shows general event-triggered automation that runs actions in response to events. Missing for 10: general event-driven triggers, webhooks or outbound actions on events, documented rule condition/consequence semantics beyond relevance overrides, independent corroboration.
